items.markdown:
The nationwide average asking price for residential property in Greece stands at **€2,561 per square meter** , with house prices having increased by nearly **94% nationwide** since 2017.[[1]](https://www.buygreece.us/greece-real-estate-statistics-2025-2026-forecast)[[2]](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DeG1uuaES_Q/)

### Average Prices by Region (2026)

- **Athens — Center:** €2,500 / sq. m (small apartments start around €150,000–€200,000; 3-bedroom units range from €300,000–€400,000)[[1]](https://tranio.com/greece/prices/)
- **Athens — South Suburbs (e.g., Glyfada, Vouliagmeni):** €4,231 / sq. m[[1]](https://tranio.com/greece/prices/)
- **Athens — North Suburbs (e.g., Ekali, Psichiko):** €3,519 / sq. m[[1]](https://tranio.com/greece/prices/)
- **Athens — West Suburbs:** €2,288 / sq. m[[1]](https://tranio.com/greece/prices/)
- **Thessaloniki:** New apartments start around €210,000[[1]](https://tranio.com/greece/prices/)
- **Chalkidiki:** Ranges from €2,000 / sq. m in standard areas up to €4,500 / sq. m in popular spots and over €10,000 / sq. m on prime beachfronts[[1]](https://www.engelvoelkers.com/de/en/resources/property-prices-greece)
- **Cyclades (Mykonos, Santorini):** Luxury villas and prime real estate frequently start well over €1,000,000 to €3,500,000+[[1]](https://search.savills.com/com/en/list/property-for-sale/greece)[[2]](https://www.engelvoelkers.com/de/en/resources/property-prices-greece)
- **Crete & Ionian Islands:** Apartments and townhouses start around €198,000–€330,000, while upscale seaside villas range from €650,000 to several million.[[1]](https://tranio.com/greece/prices/)

### Market & Investment Context

- **Golden Visa:** Investment thresholds for the Greek Golden Visa program range from **€250,000 to €800,000** depending on the specific region and municipality.
- **General Index:** You can track macroeconomic residential price movements through the [Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis (FRED)](https://fred.stlouisfed.org/series/QGRR628BIS) index data.
- **Listings:** To explore current active regional inventory, you can browse platforms like [Green-Acres Greece](https://www.green-acres.gr/en) or international listings via [RealEstate.com.au International](https://www.realestate.com.au/international/gr/).[[1]](https://www.aplaceinthesun.com/greece)[[2]](https://fred.stlouisfed.org/series/QGRR628BIS)[[3]](https://www.green-acres.gr/en)[[4]](https://www.realestate.com.au/international/gr/)
